test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Match the government schemes with their correct objectives and choose the correct option:

 
 

 
 
**Government schemes:**

 
 
 
**Objectives:**

 
 
 

 
 
(A)

 
 
 
Dak Karmayogi

 
 
 
(i)

 
 
 
Infra monitoring

 
 
 

 
 
(B)

 
 
 
India Post Payments Bank (IPPB)

 
 
 
(ii)

 
 
 
Capacity building for government personnel

 
 
 

 
 
(C)

 
 
 
Aadhaar-enabled Payment System (AePS) 

 
 
 
(iii)

 
 
 
Aadhaar-based cashless banking

 
 
 

 
 
(D)

 
 
 
PRAGATI

 
 
 
(iv)

 
 
 
Financial inclusion through doorstep banking
solution:
The correct answer is __**A-ii, B-iv, C-iii, D-i**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dak Karmayogi**:

 
 
• It is a capacity-building program aimed at enhancing the skills and competencies of government personnel, particularly those working within the postal department.
 
• The scheme focuses on training, e-learning modules, and skill enhancement for employees to improve efficiency in service delivery. ***A aligns with ii.***
 
 
 
• **India Post Payments Bank (IPPB)**:
 
 
• The objective of IPPB is to promote **financial inclusion** by providing doorstep banking services, especially to rural and underserved areas.
 
• It leverages the extensive postal network to ensure banking services reach the remotest corners of India. ***B aligns with iv.***
